items.prompt: A source supplies a naive timestamp with no zone contract. What is the safe interpretation?

options.text: It is definitely UTC for all financial sources
options.why: That would invent an unstated source contract.

options.text: Its instant is unresolved until the source zone policy is known
options.why: The clock reading alone does not specify a unique instant.

options.text: It is definitely the learner's local device timezone
options.why: The device location does not define source semantics.

options.text: It encodes the current exchange session automatically
options.why: No session identity follows just from this timestamp.

items.explanation: Recover the source timezone and ambiguity policy rather than guessing an instant from a naive clock reading.
